newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - Nov 30.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - Nov 30.

text.p: These are significant items in the Ivorian press on Saturday. Reuters has not verified these items and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Ivory Coast to pay commercial bank creditors average of 56 billion CFA francs yearly for 30 years from 1998 under accord on London Club debt signed last week, Finance Minister N'Goran Niamien tells news conference.

- Building of new abbatoir for Abidjan to start soon, says government communique after cabinet meeting. Abbatoir is one of 12 major construction projects under Ivory Coast's medium-term development programme.
- Three blocks of state-owned agri-industrial complex Palmindustrie sold for 44 billion CFA under Ivory Coast's privatisation programme.
- Only France has a real African policy, declares French ambassador to Ivory Coast Christian Dutheil de la Rochere at press luncheon ahead of Franco-African summit in Burkina Faso next week.
